'''Ulterior Vision''' was a security and investigation service led by [[Elora Silssusio]] before [[Gender/Legends|she]] joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The group did illegal work for [[Senator/Legends|senators]] until it was exposed by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
